$note: Reviewed payload table for the demo persona (fictional; see demo-timeline.md). Canonical source for exact VALUES; demo-timeline.md stays canonical for FACTS. Keys are converter-derived: '<rtype>.<date>' for point events, '<rtype>.<start>.<end|ongoing>' for period facts. An entry with a cadence expands (Rules 1/2, docs/engineering/replay-architecture.md 4.1); one without yields a single record. Meal nutrition carries method.pipeline='replay-payload-table/1' so engine/nutrition.py's is_engine_authored() leaves it alone — replay makes zero nutrition model calls. Only protein_g is stated: the story gave no carbs/fat/kcal and this table never invents a number.
$schema_note: entry := { payload | segments, cadence?, confidence?, summary?, event_time?, note? }
